long_biography.plain_text:
Intricate clocks fascinated the American businessman George Lindemann. Together with his wife, Frayda, he assembled a collection of Cartier clocks and decorative objects after a Paris shop window caught their attention. The collection reflected their different interests: she favoured natural forms, while he enjoyed the puzzle of hidden mechanisms.

Their support for music also became a lasting commitment. They endowed the Metropolitan Opera's young artist development programme, helping singers at the start of professional careers. Lindemann followed the participants' progress with enthusiasm. The couple also supported Young Concert Artists, hosted its board meetings for a decade and endowed a vocal chair to assist emerging performers.
